published.source: PR (Affliction and Fire DoT end gates)

summary: Fire Destruction with Incinerate as the filler and a Firestone.
rotation: Life Tap below 5% mana or when Incinerate costs more than the mana left
Bane of Doom when it lands before the fight ends (more than 60s left)
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when down or under 2s left (more than 9s left)
Immolate when down or under 2s left (more than 6s left)
Conflagrate on cooldown while Immolate is up
Death Coil, then Searing Pain, when the filler would not land before the fight ends
caveats: Demon sensitivity: no owner scaling 937.3, Succubus melee halved 937.4, both 913.2; without owner scaling the Succubus-sacrifice build (950.8) would be the pick (first set)
Firestone is 24 ahead of Spellstone. Felhunter is 25 behind, Imp 35.
Unverified: whether Incinerate's 25% bonus applies to the whole hit. Bane of Havoc's point does nothing.
Demon scaling uses SoD placeholders. Worth 49 on Demonology, 39 on the other builds.
Succubus base melee is unverified. Halved, it would cost Demonology 43 and the others 38 to 39.
Bane of Doom's coefficient is 4.0 (Era 1.0). At 2.0 Shadow Bolt builds lose about 4%, at 1.0 about 6%.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Shadow Bolt IX, Immolate VII, Corruption VI): 7 to 13 DPS.
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is live (the 5-piece added about +8 to +13 on the first set)
Soul shards and Life Tap's health cost aren't tracked.
Demons use the warlock's spell crit (forever-bugs #331). Worth 15 to 17 DPS.
notes: Request straight from mksettings -spec destruction_fire -gear level60_phase1_synthetic -apl level60_destruction_fire -race Human -duration 180, no edits. Demon Armor; Summon Succubus, sacrificed NoSummon, imbue Firestone. mksettings sets distanceFromTarget 5 / channelClipDelayMs 50 where the UI preset uses 25 / 150; the published numbers were made with mksettings and reproduce exactly.
